$description: Semantic color tokens that swap between light and dark themes. Names mirror the --color-* CSS variables in src/assets/css/global/base/variables.css. Values reference palette tokens from colors.json via {curly.brackets} so any palette change cascades automatically. `accent-orange` is deliberately the same value in both themes — variables.css sets it from orange-500 in light and dark alike, unlike accent-blue and accent-green, whose theme pair already reaches the design tools as the light_dark colors from colors.json. Pushed to Penpot's theme/light and theme/dark sets by build-penpot-tokens.js. `bg-head`, `text-header-dim` and dark `border-top` are flat hex rather than references: variables.css builds them with color-mix, which has no token equivalent, so these mirror the resolved values and have to be re-resolved by hand if a mix changes.
